title: One input GLiNER cannot answer no longer stops the whole capture
request: The owner: store all training data with reasoning.
spec: make capture runs to the end: a decision model's failure on one input is kept as an abstention with its error, its neighbours' answers kept.
plan: read the traceback of make capture's GLiNER step
ask a failing chunk one by one and keep the failing input as an abstention
test with a scripted model that fails on one input
resume the capture from the GLiNER step

decisions.decision: Keep the failed input as a record with value None and its error in output
decisions.why: never truncate before saving: the record is whole, and a later run with the same input is not asked again for nothing

findings.defect: make capture stopped at GLiNER's answers and never reached the snapshot
findings.scenario: 2026-11-22 capture: GLiNER2's batch_classify_text raised IndexError (argmax of an empty tensor) on one input
findings.cause: one batch call per chunk with no handling: one sample's failure ended the process
findings.fix: a failing chunk is asked one by one; an input that still fails is kept as an abstention with its error

measurements.name: store run inside make capture
measurements.result: every step ran with 0 errors, 0 refused; the first complete store run since 11-18 (nightly runs were stopped by the swap and disk guards)

measurements.name: thinking kept in the store's model exchanges since 11-03
measurements.gate: every non-error call outside a sealed exam keeps its thinking
measurements.result: 6,459 of 6,472 (99.8%); the 13 without are Claude calls of 11-04 and 11-06; sealed exam calls are kept as shape only by policy

outcome: The capture's GLiNER step survives a bad input; the capture is resumed to the snapshot.
lessons: A batch call to a model needs a per-item fallback, or one input stops everything after it.
Count thinking under every field it is kept in (thinking_redacted too) before calling it missing.
risks: The nightly store run still does not fit in memory on some nights (swap over 6 GB at the decision sets).
